name: jev-typesafeai
description: Verbatim, selective-deletion compaction for Claude Code, scored by TypeSafe's Jev model.

typesafeApiKey.description: TypeSafe API key used to call the Jev model. Falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable if unset.

compactAtPercent.description: Context-window percent at which compaction is proactively triggered.

preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of most-recent messages (plus the first message) that are never touched.

maxStateTokens.description: Token budget for the conversation state sent to Jev.

keepThreshold.description: Score threshold (0-1) above which a tool call or result is kept.

truncateHeadChars.description: Characters kept from a tool result when it is truncated rather than dropped.

minReductionRatio.description: Minimum token-reduction ratio required to accept the Jev-compacted result; otherwise falls back to the default summary.
